note: BCMA depleters (CAR-T such as ide-cel, the ADC belantamab mafodotin) entered relapsed/refractory myeloma on BCMA+ xenografts in immunodeficient mice, plus rat and rabbit toxicology for the ADC.
label: Myeloma (BCMA)

engagement.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma with BCMA-expressing plasma cells (NCI CAR-BCMA)
engagement.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient (NSG) mice, CAR-T
engagement.note: First anti-BCMA CAR T cells killed BCMA+ myeloma and eradicated xenografts in immunodeficient mice; no patient read-out yet.
engagement.quote: The anti-BCMA-CAR-transduced T cells exhibited BCMA-specific functions including cytokine production, proliferation, cytotoxicity, and in vivo tumor eradication.

engagement.magnitude_basis: depletion of BCMA+ marrow plasma cells (flow cytometry)
engagement.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma with BCMA-expressing plasma cells (NCI CAR-BCMA)
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Ali 2016; two patients at the top dose level.
engagement.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient (NSG) mice, CAR-T
engagement.note: In the first-in-human CAR-BCMA trial, BCMA+ marrow plasma cells became undetectable at the top dose, the killing the xenografts showed.
engagement.short: Marrow plasma cells cleared in patients
engagement.quote: After treatment, bone marrow plasma cells became undetectable by flow cytometry, and the patient's MM entered a stringent complete remission that lasted for 17 weeks before relapse.
engagement.reason: Plasma cells cleared as model said
engagement.judgement: Readout taken as loss of the BCMA-bearing cell, scored downstream because no occupancy or free-target assay was the model's readout. Paired by me: Ali cites but does not compare with the xenograft. Soluble-BCMA elimination after ide-cel (FDA Abecma SBRA 2021) is later and not compared with any model either.

dose.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after at least 3 prior lines
dose.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient (NSG) mice, CAR-T
dose.note: Xenografts showed dose-dependent activity, but no cell-dose or exposure target was carried into patients; doses were escalated empirically. Dated 2015, ide-cel's own first use in this xenograft system (Chekmasova 2015), not 2013: a drug's track opens at that drug's first use in the model, not the system's first use for another CAR.
dose.short: Mouse doses set no human target
dose.quote: intravenous administration of ABECMA demonstrated dose-dependent anti-tumor activity and improved survival compared to control mice.
dose.judgement: Opens at ide-cel's first use in the model (Chekmasova 2015); Carpenter 2013 dosed a different CAR. The FDA summary is the source that names the filed model. Teclistamab's ex vivo EC90 dose model (v2 lead) dropped: teclistamab is not a member of this tile.

dose.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after prior lines of therapy
dose.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient mice, ADC
dose.note: Belantamab eliminated xenografts in mice; DREAMM-1 escalated 0.03-4.6 mg/kg to an MTD-type endpoint, not to a model exposure target.
dose.quote: Importantly, J6M0-mcMMAF rapidly eliminates myeloma cells in subcutaneous and disseminated mouse models, and mice remain tumor-free up to 3.5 months.
dose.judgement: No source states a xenograft exposure target or a tolerated-margin claim for the effective dose, so decision 16 does not apply; the corneal harm is counted once, in safety. DREAMM-1 (Trudel 2018, doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(18)30576-X) primary endpoints were MTD and RP2D. Vonsetamig (antibody) has no myeloma dose data found.

dose.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after prior lines of therapy
dose.note: GSK's integrated PopPK, M-protein tumour-growth and keratopathy Markov simulation framework for belantamab regimens, built to choose doses and schedule extensions.
dose.quote: Integrating models allows simulations that support dosing considerations.
dose.confidence_note: Abstract and full text (PMC13238829) read. First use proxied by publication; component models may be older.
dose.judgement: Opening entry at first public use. The framework was fitted on DREAMM-6/7/8 data, so its comparisons with those trials are retrodictions (next entry).
dose.model: Belantamab PopPK + M-protein tumour-growth + keratopathy Markov simulation framework

dose.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after at least 1 prior line (DREAMM-7, DREAMM-8)
dose.note: Simulating DREAMM-7/8 protocol dosing reproduced trial VGPR+ (62.0% vs 62.0%; 60.2% vs 68.0%), PFS and grade>=3 eye findings, but on data it was fitted to. Combination trials: belantamab with bortezomib-dexamethasone (DREAMM-7) and pomalidomide-dexamethasone (DREAMM-8); both reproduced, so one entry.
dose.short: Reproduces DREAMM-7/8 on its own data
dose.quote: This framework adequately predicted outcomes from DREAMM‐7/DREAMM‐8, supporting its use to predict benefit‐risk profiles of alternate belantamab mafodotin dosing strategies.
dose.confidence_note: Full text (PMC13238829): M-protein and KVA models include DREAMM-7 and DREAMM-8 patients, and the same data were used for verification.
dose.reason: Retrodiction of the trials it was fitted to
dose.judgement: Scored retro, not same: the trials' results were known (DREAMM-7 and -8 published 2024) and their data were used to build the model. Placed in dose because the framework's purpose is regimen choice; its prospective alternative-regimen predictions remain untested.
dose.magnitude_basis: simulated vs observed VGPR+ rate and grade>=3 ophthalmic exam finding rate (87.5% vs 76.5%; 77.2% vs 82.5%)
dose.model: Belantamab PopPK + M-protein tumour-growth + keratopathy Markov simulation framework

efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma with BCMA-expressing plasma cells (NCI CAR-BCMA)
efficacy.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient (NSG) mice, CAR-T
efficacy.note: Anti-BCMA CAR T cells eradicated established human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient mice; no patient comparison yet.
efficacy.quote: The anti-BCMA-CAR-transduced T cells exhibited BCMA-specific functions including cytokine production, proliferation, cytotoxicity, and in vivo tumor eradication.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: xenograft tumour-free survival vs patient overall response rate
efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma refractory to a PI and an IMiD, anti-CD38 exposed (DREAMM-2)
efficacy.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient mice, ADC
efficacy.note: DREAMM-2 met its primary response endpoint (31% at 2.5 mg/kg), as the ADC xenografts predicted, though far short of the mice's cures. Design: open-label, two doses randomised, no comparator; primary endpoint overall response.
efficacy.quote: 30 (31%; 97·5% CI 20·8-42·6) of 97 patients in the 2·5 mg/kg cohort and 34 (34%; 23·9-46·0) of 99 patients in the 3·4 mg/kg cohort achieved an overall response.

patient_trials.quote: Final analysis results from DREAMM-3, a phase 3 study of belantamab mafodotin versus pomalidomide plus dexamethasone in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

efficacy.judgement: The first trial of a member drug whose primary endpoint was efficacy; earlier CAR-BCMA phase 1s (Ali 2016, Raje 2019) had safety primaries. Ide-cel's KarMMa result now sits on the CAR-T xenograft track (its own entry), not here. DREAMM-3 missed PFS superiority over pomalidomide-dexamethasone, an active comparator the xenograft never addressed; left unscored pending a ruling on active-comparator superiority trials. DREAMM-7/8 combinations (met PFS, 2024) would not change this track's status.

efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after at least 3 prior lines
efficacy.note: bb2121 killed every BCMA+ line in a receptor-quantified panel, below 1000 BCMA molecules per cell, implying tumour BCMA level should not select responders.
efficacy.short: Kills cells with very low BCMA
efficacy.quote: Based on receptor density quantification, bb2121 can recognize tumor cells expressing less than 1000 BCMA molecules per cell.
efficacy.confidence_note: ASH 2015 abstract (Blood 126(23):3094, published 3 Dec 2015) read in full; Friedman 2018 (PMID 29641319) refines the floor to 222 molecules per cell.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry moved from Friedman 2018 to the ASH 2015 abstract, the panel's first public date (rule 6), which precedes every CAR-BCMA patient result.
efficacy.model: bb2121 CAR T cytotoxicity against cell lines of quantified BCMA density (in vitro)

efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after at least 3 prior lines, split by tumour BCMA expression (CRB-401)
efficacy.note: In CRB-401, response to ide-cel did not depend on tumour BCMA expression (100% vs 91% at <50% vs >=50% BCMA+ plasma cells), as the low-density cell panel predicted. Dated to the ASH 2017 abstract, where the response-by-BCMA split was first public; not a retrodiction, since the panel was public in 2015.
efficacy.quote: Response appeared to be independent of tumor BCMA expression, with similarly high response rates observed at tumor BCMA expression levels of less than 50% and 50% or more in patients who received 450×10⁶ CAR+ T cells.
efficacy.confidence_note: Quote from the author manuscript (PMC8202968) read via a page fetch, not the NEJM PDF. Small subgroups at the 450x10^6 dose; response was a secondary end point (primary was safety). CRB-401 (NCT02658929) has no results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.
efficacy.judgement: Patient-level prediction scored on the response-by-BCMA subgroup rather than the primary end point, because the model's claim is about which patients respond; endpoint_role left null. Paired: Raje restates the preclinical claim in its introduction but does not set it beside the subgroup, so comparison_stated false.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: ORR by screening tumour BCMA <50% vs >=50% at 450x10^6 CAR+ T cells (100% vs 91%)
efficacy.model: bb2121 CAR T cytotoxicity against cell lines of quantified BCMA density (in vitro)
BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient (NSG) mice, CAR-T
efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after at least 3 prior lines
efficacy.quote: In contrast, treatment with bb2121 resulted in rapid and sustained elimination of the tumors, increased body weights, and 100% survival.
efficacy.note: bb2121 (ide-cel) cleared RPMI-8226 myeloma xenografts in NSG mice with 100% survival, before any ide-cel patient was dosed.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry for the ide-cel track of the CAR-T xenograft system, at its first public use for this drug.

efficacy.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient (NSG) mice, CAR-T
efficacy.magnitude_basis: xenograft tumour elimination vs patient overall response rate
efficacy.confidence_note: Quote checked verbatim in the NEJM abstract (PMID 33626253) by the checker; year from the 2019 BMS/bluebird top-line release.
efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after at least 3 prior lines
efficacy.quote: At a median follow-up of 13.3 months, 94 of 128 patients (73%) had a response, and 42 of 128 (33%) had a complete response or better.
efficacy.note: KarMMa met its primary response endpoint (73%), as the bb2121 xenografts predicted. Design: single-arm phase 2, primary overall response by independent review.
efficacy.judgement: Split from the belantamab entry, which had pooled it: a CAR-T result belongs on the CAR-T xenograft's ide-cel track. Dated to the 2019 top-line press release (rule 6); the NEJM paper sets the status. Paired by me.

safety.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after at least 3 prior lines
safety.model: BCMA+ human myeloma xenografts in immunodeficient (NSG) mice, CAR-T
safety.note: NSG xenografts lack human myeloid and cytokine compartments, so their silence on cytokine release and neurotoxicity was no prediction. The summary's 'no adverse findings' is a passing tolerability claim, scored only against harms NSG mice could show; CRS, cytopenias and hypogammaglobulinaemia are not among them. Dated 2015, ide-cel's own first use in this xenograft system (Chekmasova 2015), not 2013: a drug's track opens at that drug's first use in the model, not the system's first use for another CAR.
safety.short: Mouse silent on CRS, could not show it
safety.quote: No ABECMA-related adverse findings were reported in these studies.
safety.judgement: v2 scored this contra; under v3 a mouse that cannot show cytokine release is not wrong by staying silent. CRS (84%) and neurotoxicity (18%) in KarMMa are on-target, so pooled with no modality.

safety.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after prior lines of therapy
safety.model: Rat and rabbit repeat-dose toxicology (belantamab mafodotin)
safety.note: Rats and rabbits showed corneal epithelial single-cell necrosis from non-BCMA uptake of the MMAF conjugate before patients were dosed.
safety.quote: Belantamab mafodotin increased mitoses of corneal epithelial cells with bilateral single cell necrosis in rats.

safety.magnitude_basis: corneal epithelial injury: minimal non-adverse in rats vs 44% severe keratopathy
safety.population: Relapsed/refractory myeloma after prior lines of therapy
safety.confidence_note: The FDA review reports both sides but does not compare them; the applicant called the rat finding non-adverse.
safety.model: Rat and rabbit repeat-dose toxicology (belantamab mafodotin)
safety.note: Keratopathy hit 71% of DREAMM-2 patients, 44% severe: the corneal harm the rat and rabbit studies showed, though they judged it minor. The rat finding was called non-adverse, but the harm itself was shown, so it is scored as predicted in kind.
safety.short: Keratopathy in patients, as in rats
safety.quote: Keratopathy was the most frequently reported toxicity with belantamab mafodotin, with an overall incidence of 71%, and 44% of patients experiencing at least one episode of severe keratopathy at the 2.5 mg/kg dose level.
safety.judgement: Scored same in direction (harm predicted, harm seen) rather than contra: severity misjudged gives direction_only. Platform harm (MMAF; drug does not bind rat BCMA), so split to ADC. Dated to the review, the first public record of the animal finding; patient keratopathy was public from DREAMM-1 (2018).
